name: IntPhys 2019
description: Benchmark for visual intuitive physics that measures models' ability to reason about physical plausibility from video clips.
reputation: A well-known synthetic-physics video benchmark used in vision and physical-reasoning research, though adoption is concentrated in the video-physical-reasoning subcommunity.
notes: Non-LLM, synthetic 3D scenes; relatively small and constrained set of scenarios so models can exploit low-level cues; not saturated but domain-specific.
